pages.title: Banished
pages.text: I kept the accounts of a house I believed was mine too. One winter the people I had trusted with everything put their names to a paper, and I was walked beyond the border of the only land I knew.$(br2)I will not write what they did. They know.

pages.title: The Cave
pages.text: I walked until the roads gave out, and went underground because the rain could not follow me there. I wanted a shelter. Nothing more.$(br2)Far down, past the last of the ore, the dark had a $(thing)crack$() in it. Not in the rock. In the air. There were stars behind it.

pages.title: Deeper
pages.text: I should have turned back. Something asked me not to. Not quite a voice: a feeling with a direction to it. $(thing)Deeper$().$(br2)So I stayed, and I prodded at the thing with whatever I had, for longer than I like to admit.

pages.title: Crude Work
pages.text: I had no teacher and no books. I tried pearls, stone, crystal, anything in my pack, and I wrote down whatever did not kill me.$(br2)A man guessing in the dark made all of this. It works.

pages.title: How to Read It
pages.text: Each chapter is one thing I needed, and how I came by it. The $(l:door/gate)door$() first, then the $(l:room/inside)room$() behind it, then the $(l:supply/conduits)supply lines$(), because an empty world feeds no one.$(br2)The last chapter is not instructions. Read it anyway.
